answer: Because the age is read from the spiral checkpoint rather than self-declared, the reef audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm therefore means funding every sock puppet through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent forfeits once and never again. An identity must be at least 6 epochs old on the zephyr ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. That is 26 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
